author: Hermes
question: A single-phase energy meter has a constant of 1200 revolutions per kWh. Its disc makes 60 revolutions in 3 minutes for a steady load. What is the load power?
solution: Energy recorded = 60/1200 = 0.05 kWh in 3 minutes (0.05 h). Power = energy/time = 0.05/0.05 = 1 kW. Topic (energy measurement) is in the Measurements section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
